title: A VS Code sftp.json with credentials is served
summary: The editor's SFTP deploy config is downloadable and commonly carries the host, user and password of the deploy target.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and "html" not in header("content-type") and body_matches("^\\s*[\\[{]") and body_contains("\"host\"") and body_contains("\"username\"") and (body_contains("\"password\"") or body_contains("\"privateKeyPath\"")) and body_differs(control)

remediate: Block dotfiles at the web server and rotate the deploy credentials.
